text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. First-class Umamusume
are also exceptionally gifted at gauging their rivals' strength.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The winner of this race will definitely be that Umamusume,
number 3—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Goooal!! This is razor-close!!
Is it Number 1, or is it Number 3?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, yes, number 3 made a late push for the win.
Well then, it's about time for training—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The results are in! 1st place goes to Number 1!
Number 1 leads all the way to victory!!

text_block_list.name: Discerning Tipster
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, nailed it again!
I really am a top-notch tipster, aren't I!

text_block_list.name: Track Tipster's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, incredible!
How did you know which one would take 1st place!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph, that was just a fluke.
Some "first-rate tipster" you are. I'll definitely...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kiiiiiiieeee!!
Kh... One more time! Just one more time!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep trying until I hit the jackpot--!!

And so, completely forgetting about training,
King Halo became engrossed in making predictions...
